project.name: Obelisk Proof Assistant
project.author: Georgy Dunaev
project.description: Systematic database of classical logic, Morse–Kelley foundations, type-theoretic side conditions, and reflected metatheory.

sections.title: Propositional logic
sections.description: Classical propositional calculus axioms A01–A12 and Modus Ponens inference rule.

entries.title: A01 (Affirmation of Consequent)
entries.notes: Positive implicative axiom.

entries.title: A02 (Distribution of Implication)
entries.notes: Self-distribution of implication.

entries.title: A03 (Conjunction Elimination Left)
entries.notes: Left projection.

entries.title: A04 (Conjunction Elimination Right)
entries.notes: Right projection.

entries.title: A05 (Conjunction Introduction)
entries.notes: Pairing of propositional truths.

entries.title: A06 (Disjunction Introduction Left)
entries.notes: Left injection.

entries.title: A07 (Disjunction Introduction Right)
entries.notes: Right injection.

entries.title: A08 (Disjunction Elimination / Cases)
entries.notes: Proof by cases.

entries.title: A09 (Negation Introduction / Contradiction)
entries.notes: Contradiction to bottom.

entries.title: A10 (Reductio Ad Absurdum)
entries.notes: Proof of negation.

entries.title: A11 (Ex Falso Quodlibet)
entries.notes: Principle of explosion.

entries.title: A12 (Law of Excluded Middle)
entries.notes: Classical tertium non datur.

entries.title: Modus Ponens (MP)
entries.notes: Fundamental detachment rule.

sections.title: Predicate logic
sections.description: First-order predicate calculus with typed domain, Bernays rules, substitution, and eigenvariable conditions.

entries.title: Discourse domain is non-empty
entries.notes: Ensures the universe of discourse contains at least one class.

entries.title: Forall Instantiation (FI)
entries.notes: Term t is free for substitution for variable identifier v_x in formula φ.

entries.title: Exists Instantiation (EI)
entries.notes: Witness substitution into existential quantifier.

entries.title: Forall Abstraction (FA / Bernays)
entries.notes: Eigenvariable condition: variable identifier v_x does not occur free in antecedent ψ or context Γ.

entries.title: Exists Abstraction (EA / Bernays)
entries.notes: Dual eigenvariable condition: v_x not free in consequent ψ or assumptions.

entries.title: Generalisation (Gen)
entries.notes: Universal generalization over variable identifier v_x not free in active context Γ.

sections.title: Set/class-theoretic foundations of mathematics
sections.description: Morse–Kelley (MK) axiomatic class theory with Dunaev tagged ordered pairs, class comprehension, class conditional if-then-else, simple_if, dependent_if, and Ordinal Induction.

entries.title: Class Comprehension Axiom
entries.notes: Predicative/impredicative comprehension for all first-order and higher-order formulas.

entries.title: Extensionality Axiom
entries.semantic: ∀(A, B : Class) ((∀(x : Class) (x ∈ A ⟷ x ∈ B)) → A = B)
entries.semantic_latex: \\forall (A, B : \\mathsf{Class})\\; ((\\forall (x : \\mathsf{Class})\\; (x \\in A \\longleftrightarrow x \\in B)) \\to A = B)
entries.notes: Two classes having identical elements are identical.

entries.title: Heredity Axiom (Subclasses of Sets are Sets)
entries.notes: Any subclass of a set is a set.

entries.title: Regularity (Foundation) Axiom
entries.notes: Every non-empty class contains an ∈-minimal element. Rules out infinite descending ∈-chains.

entries.title: Pairing Axiom
entries.notes: Unordered pair of two sets is a set.

entries.title: Union Axiom
entries.notes: The unary union of any set is a set.

entries.title: IF-THEN-ELSE-FI (Class conditional with NFV side condition and context turnstile)
entries.semantic: W, Γ ⊢ ⟦IF ψ THEN A ELSE B FI⟧ = { v | (ψ ∧ v ∈ A) ∨ (¬ψ ∧ v ∈ B) }
entries.semantic_latex: \mathcal{W}, \Gamma \vdash \llbracket \mathrm{IF}\; \psi\; \mathrm{THEN}\; A\; \mathrm{ELSE}\; B\; \mathrm{FI} \rrbracket = \{ v \mid (\psi \land v \in A) \lor (\neg\psi \land v \in B) \}
entries.notes: Class-level conditional defined via class comprehension. The syntactic constructor IF-THEN-ELSE-FI denotes a class valuation ⟦IF ψ THEN A ELSE B FI⟧. Soundness requires variable identifier v_v not free in formula ψ or context Γ.

entries.title: Power Class Axiom
entries.notes: Power class of any set is a set.

entries.title: Replacement / Limitation of Size Axiom
entries.notes: Image of a set under a class function is a set.

entries.title: Infinity Axiom
entries.semantic: ∃(x : Class) (isSet(x) ∧ ∅ ∈ x ∧ ∀(y : Class) (y ∈ x → y ∪ {y} ∈ x))
entries.notes: Guarantees existence of the set of natural numbers ω.
entries.interpretation_code: ∃(x : Class) (isSet(x) ∧ ∅ ∈ x ∧ ∀(y : Class) (y ∈ x → y ∪ {y} ∈ x))
entries.semantic_typing: ∃(x : Class) (isSet(x) ∧ ∅ ∈ x ∧ ∀(y : Class) (y ∈ x → y ∪ {y} ∈ x))

entries.semantic_membership_latex: \\exists x \\; (\\mathrm{isSet}(x) \\land \\emptyset \\in x \\land \\forall y \\; (y \\in x \\to y \\cup \\{y\\} \\in x))

entries.title: Global Choice Axiom
entries.notes: Global choice function over all non-empty sets.

entries.title: Universal Class (V)
entries.notes: Universe of all sets. V is a proper class (not a set).

entries.title: Transitive Class Predicate
entries.notes: A class is transitive if every element of it is also a subclass.

entries.title: Tarski's Axiom of Universes
entries.notes: Grothendieck-Tarski universes: every set belongs to a transitive, power-closed universe.
